# Olive and June

A DTC **nail** brand and the archetype of the at-home manicure shift described in
[[At-Home Nail Care Disruption]].

## Trajectory

- Salon-founder origin, then online DTC.
- Grew into mass retail as a leading at-home nail brand.
- Acquired by [[Helen of Troy]], which runs it as a standalone line.

Its press-on and gel starter kits anchor the [[Press-On Nails Market]].
